lastCompletedStory.title: Give an unterminated oracle mark a loud malformed kind instead of a silent null

openQuestions: Deferred gap (by this story's own honest-scope-boundary clause, not a bug): a malformed directive is loud only to a caller that inspects the parsed kind or runs runBehavioralGate on it. lintStoryCriteria (src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts:661) still does `if (directive.kind !== 'named-command' && directive.kind !== 'file-assert') continue;`, so plan-time lint stays silent on malformed. The reviewer contract's Layer B step still filters to 'kind named-command or file-assert', so malformed is not yet a review-blocking finding. Wiring either surface is out of this story's scope and belongs in a follow-up filed by the orchestrator via /cam-issue on main.
nextStoryContext: behavioral-gate.ts's OracleDirective union now has a 5th member: MalformedOracle { kind: 'malformed'; raw: string }. Boundary vs the pre-existing NoRunnableOracle ('no-oracle'): no-oracle means an oracle mark WAS extracted (bracket balanced) but its payload is empty or an unrecognized bare label (e.g. bare 'file-assert', bare 'named-command'); malformed means the LAST `[oracle:` opener's bracket never balances at all, so no payload can be extracted -- exactly the case that returned null on main before this story. extractLastOracleRaw (private) now returns a 3-way discriminated result `{ kind: 'absent' } | { kind: 'found'; raw } | { kind: 'unterminated'; raw }` instead of `string | null`; 'absent' (no `[oracle:` substring anywhere) is the only case parseOracleDirective still maps to `null` -- a criterion with genuinely no oracle mark is unaffected. resolveNonRunnableResult in the same file now refuses 'malformed' BEFORE the `directive as NamedCommandOracle | FileAssertOracle` cast, mirroring how it already refuses reviewer-judgment/no-oracle/tmux-pty; this ordering is load-bearing (AC2 pins zero tmux calls for a malformed directive). lintStoryCriteria (prd-oracle-lint.ts) and the reviewer's Layer B contract are UNCHANGED and deliberately still skip the malformed kind -- see openQuestions for the deferred follow-up. No PRD/prd.json changes required by this story.
